mentions.name: Patch-style Web MIDI synth
mentions.description: A simple patch-style synthesizer built as an early experiment to explore the Web MIDI APIs and React Flow, letting users play with and connect patch-style sound modules. It lives on the author's personal "try things and learn" site.
mentions.audience: Part of the author's personal "try things and learn" site, made as a personal experiment to play with the APIs.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I threw together a simple patch-style synth to play with the Web MIDI APIs and React Flow. It’s an early experiment and part of my personal “try things and learn” site.

https://www.futile.com/patch
